'''Elvaine Martan''' is an [[Andoran]] noblewoman.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Elvaine Martan}} She is the wife of [[Brannin Martan]] who is the High Seat of House Martan.

== Appearance ==
She is gray haired.

== Activities ==
She is one of the nobles to have thrown their support behind [[Elayne Trakand]] and brought their extended family as armsmen to [[Caemlyn]].

When Elayne is captured by the [[Black Ajah]], Elvaine, Brannin and their armsmen aid [[Birgitte Silverbow]] in rescuing her.
